"""Tide windows for the survey boats."""
from survey.limits import TIDE_MARGIN_MINUTES


def tide_window(margin=TIDE_MARGIN_MINUTES):
    """Return the tide window the survey boats work in."""
    return "tide-%d" % margin


def window_name(margin):
    return "window-%d" % margin
